This '''species''' was a bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their [[Color|orange]] skin, as well as a pair of fin-like growth on top of their head and four pointed barbs extending from their face, and two tube-like growths wrapping around each of the sides of their head.<ref name="BOBF2" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{BoBFDate}}</ref> at least two members of this species visited [[Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary]] in [[Mos Espa]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]],<ref name="BOBF2" /> with one of them being present when [[Destruction of Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|Sanctuary was blown up]] by the [[Pyke Syndicate]].<ref name="BOBF6">{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}}</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine|second episode]] of the television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]],'' written by [[Jon Favreau]] and directed by [[Steph Green]].<ref name="BOBF2" /> The species shared many traits with [[Unidentified barbed green species|another species]] created for the [[Chapter 9: The Marshal|first episode]] of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],''<ref name="Mando9">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 9: The Marshal}}</ref> referred to behind the scenes by makeup artist [[Brian Sipe]] and team simply by the nickname "Catfish."<ref name="Gallery">{{DisneyGallery|Disney Gallery: The Mandalorian: Making of Season Two|Making of Season Two}}</ref>
